new.title: Seek Kayqubad's lakeside summer palace at Kubadabad
new.desc: Kubadabad was a complex of summer residences built for the Seljuk sultan Kayqubad I (r. 1220-1237) on the shore of Lake Beyşehir. Excavations since 1980 have uncovered tiled halls, stucco and ceramics from the Great and Small Palaces.
new.tip: About 20 km west of Beyşehir on the lake road; the ruins are open air, so go in dry weather. Check at the site for access.
